scope: Small structural follow-up; no optimizer changes
changes: Allocate frame children, back edges and resolved-bootstrap lists only when needed; skip empty leaves.
Retain the immutable graph recipe list until the first cut, then copy the exact positional prefix and append accepted registrations.
Check cancellation and return the existing empty byproduct schedule when immutable graph metadata proves there are no byproducts.
equivalence_arguments: All four cut exits preserve the cut-output mark and copy the prefix at its registration index, retaining repeated pattern objects and their order.
Byproduct registration remains before all cut predicates. Every recipe input is scanned before resolving back edges, including returned inputs after a rejected edge.
Resolved bootstrap candidates are installed only after every back edge succeeds; a rejected recipe installs none.
Children still use LinkedHashSet first-occurrence equality/order, with no changes to DFS loops or checkpoints. All consumers of retained recipe lists are read-only or copy before sorting.
CraftGraph recipe lists are immutable; recipe projections recompute byproduct metadata, including normalized container remainders. patternsByOutput contains retained original patterns only.

Without byproducts, the original schedule builder could only return the same empty maps and unchanged order, including its local work-cap fallback; the early return keeps an explicit cancellation checkpoint.
performance: Not benchmarked independently. The coordinating instance owns full-suite regression, artifact build, broader corpus differential and final combined ABBA.
